title: 第7章 出大事了第8章 四品剑
content_zh:
第七章 出大事了
叶石的出现，吸引住全部世家子弟的目光，直到这时他们才想起来，张羊之所以有这柄巨剑，完全是眼前之人贩卖所得。那么是不是只要他们和眼前之人打好关系，他们也能够获得品质不差的剑呢。
“这位大哥……”有一名世家子弟想要说话，却想起自己连对方的名字也不知道，顿时脸色一红，不好意思再说下去。
“我叫叶石，是一名铸剑师。”叶石很快解决了世家子弟们的窘境，对于自己的名字没人知道，叶石很放得开。
本来铸剑师就不是特别受待见的职业，随着剑道文明发展，用剑之人占据天下十之八九，铸剑师自然也应声而起。除非是铸剑技巧十分高超，能够打造出无与伦比的宝剑的铸剑师，否则普通的铸剑师一文不值，因为这样的人太多了。
只是现在，叶石用一柄巨剑证明了自己的价值，这才让世家子弟们重视了起来，想要和叶石拉近关系。见到张羊手中的巨剑如此了得，他们又怎么甘愿再用普通的剑具，剑是修行之根本，谁也不想在起步上就慢人一步。
叶石在说出自己名字后，再次强调自己铸剑师的身份，因为他马上就要开始忽悠之举。见对他的自称，世家子弟们都眼前一亮，叶石便知道自己第一步已经成功了，便又抛下一饵，“张羊手中的巨剑是我打造的。”
尽管之前已经知道，但这时叶石的肯定，也让世家子弟们都变得更加热情起来，甚至已经有几个凑了上来。
“叶石大哥，我见张羊手中的巨剑质地不错，是一柄好剑，能铸此剑可见大哥铸剑术极为了得。”一名世家子弟立马拍起马屁。
尽管以他们的身份，在高日城几乎没有人值得他们溜须拍马，但这事关乎自身利益，一点点的委屈算得了什么。
“对了，我还没介绍我自己。”那名世家子弟微笑一声，谦逊的道：“我叫何涌，叶石大哥如若不嫌弃，喊我一声何涌便可以了。”
“还有我，我叫许潮平。”
“我叫黄云开。”
世家子弟们纷纷报上自己的名字，对叶石好不亲热，幸亏这次来此的都是男辈，不至于让叶石感到尴尬。但也因为如此，让叶石起了一阵鸡皮疙瘩，有些怀疑自己是不是落入背背山之手。
“大哥？”张羊有些紧张的看着叶石，他就怕大哥被这些世家子弟给忽悠走了，好不容易认了个大哥，张羊可不想这样没了。
“没事，大家都是朋友，交流交流。”叶石笑道。
被世家子弟忽悠走？叶石岂会被这么几句马屁给轰得找不着北，正所谓马屁耳边过，金币心中留。叶石一开始就冲着金币来着，忽悠？那可是叶石的看家本领，除了当初的无良客服，谁是叶石的对手。
张羊闻言眼神一黯，对于大哥的话，张羊很理解，因为大哥是铸剑师，又是一家剑坊的老板，做生意很正常，但张羊心里依然有些失落。
这时叶石却是走到张羊的身旁，拍了拍张羊的肩膀，小声的对张羊说道：“别担心，我还是你大哥，这次做完生意有钱了，大哥帮你把巨崛回炉加工，保你的巨崛再上一层。”
这话叶石放得很轻，除了张羊没人听见，外人看来叶石像是在安慰失落的张羊，那些世家子弟们也都表示理解。

只有张羊眼前一亮，暗道大哥没有抛弃他，而且这次生意挣了钱，还要用来给他加工巨崛，这让张羊又是感动不已，为之前怀疑大哥的想法感到羞愧。
其实张羊是误会了叶石的意思，叶石是说做完生意有钱了，就帮他把巨崛回炉加工。但并没有说这钱是用在上面的，但因为叶石这句话不清不楚，张羊又先入为主的情况下，就被张羊这样认为了。
叶石看见张羊感动的模样，心中暗呼一声成了。没错，哪怕多了这么多客户，但张羊这活广告却不能断，因为只有张羊让叶石感到放心，这和张羊的性格有关，而且张羊把他当做大哥，叶石自然也会在便宜之时，帮上其一把，反正这对谁都有好处，给别人不如就给张羊。
“叶石大哥，张羊手中的巨剑却是很强，但我们都是走灵活路线，巨剑看来不适合我们。”这时有人提了出来。
叶石看了过去，没想到提出这话的正是何涌，显然何涌说出了大伙的心思，在何涌说出这话后，世家子弟们都点了点头，一脸希夷的望着叶石，就怕叶石说出什么可惜了的话来。
“没问题的。”叶石咧嘴一笑，“我店里有着几种剑具，轻盈灵敏的，侧重防御的，诡异多变的，应有尽有，哪怕没有也可以订做，质地也不会比现在的巨崛差多少，各位可以到我店里一趟，你们便会明白的。”
叶石的话让世家子弟们心动不已，恨不得马上过去一瞧，如果说之前只是对张羊那巨剑的质量心动，那这时则是在得知有适合自己的剑具时，所产生的迫不及待，好想立马就将那柄宝剑握在手中。
“各位先等一下，小店刚开张，里面有些繁杂，不如等我先回去整理一番，各位晚一点再过来，如何？”叶石连忙阻止下马上要动身的众多世家子弟。
见众多世家子弟都停了下来，叶石才松了口气，尽管这么多肥羊让叶石很幸兴奋，但他们可不比张羊，对于这些人的欠款叶石很难相信。但要是这会说出你们多准备金币吧，不然待会没钱付账，恐怕会引起众怒。
好在叶石也有办法，认了张羊这么一个小弟，不就是为了这个时候起用场吗，于是叶石对张羊交代了几句，便匆匆离开。
叶石可以想象在张羊告之他们价格之后，这群世家子弟会是怎样的表情，现在叶石算是看清楚了，金币面额很大，就算是世家子弟也不是很多。
回去，开店，静等，叶石做好一切后，就坐在柜台处傻笑起来。尽管离开庄园前，他听到了一阵阵惊吼声，但叶石不怕这群世家子弟不上钩。哪怕有几个不来，挣那么三四个，叶石也就心满意足了。
这时，叶石剑坊的动向也被几个武器铺注意起来，对于这么一个新开的竞争店铺，他们还是很上心的。
此时几个武器铺的老板都聚集一起，坐在水榭客栈的茶座间里，商量着怎么把这个新生的竞争对手给打压下去。本来生意就难做，现在还有人想要分碗羹，几名老板自然不会允许。
“宋老板，你说对这叶石剑坊，该怎么做？”一名肥头大耳的粗汉问道。
被问的宋老板，则是一名普通体格的中年男子，看他温文儒雅的气质还以为是什么教书先生，而不像是一个武器铺的老板。
“不用着急，我已经派人打听过了，这叶石剑坊设置简单，搬过来后就没再置入设备，恐怕存剑卖完就只能到外地取剑，质量肯定不会过关，对我们威胁不大。”宋老板微笑的喝了口茶，语气间根本没将这新开的叶石剑坊当回事，“再有，这叶石剑坊只有一个年轻的老板，从他的年纪上看，最多二十来岁，无论是铸剑还是生意，经验肯定不足，不成忧患。”
“那么看来，不用我们动手，这叶石剑坊自己就会倒闭吧”粗汉大笑道。
“蔡老板这会不担心了吧。”另外一名瘦弱中年男子此时开口。
“当然，听你们这么说，我还担心什么，这年头，毛都没长齐的小子也敢出来开剑坊。”蔡老板一阵摇头，那肥头大耳的模样摇起头来显得极为滑稽。

“蔡老板，滕老板，我们也不能掉以轻心，小心阴沟里翻了船。”宋老板劝道，但脸上却是表露了出来，这话就连他自己也没有放在心上。
另外两名老板也是嘿嘿的笑了起来，看见宋老板沉着冷静的模样，显然已经将这叶石剑坊分析透底，想想之前自己还一副如临大敌的模样，在这点上确实比不上宋老板，难怪他们的店始终在宋老板之下。
“可笑我刚刚还派来一个人去叶石剑坊门口蹲着，见有情况便回来禀报，看来是多此一举了。”滕老板干笑一声，却是先说了出来。
现在说出来没有面子，但要是等之后那人过来禀报才曝光，那面子就丢得更大了，就希望那人能够机灵点，不要大惊小怪的什么事都传过来，不然在其他两位老板面前，他就要丢一个大面子了。
事实总会违背人的期望，就在滕老板还一心期望蹲点的那人不要过来，就听见一阵熟悉的叫喊，然后一个熟悉的人影出现在眼前，朝着他们跑来。
一边跑，还一边喊着：“老板，出大事了，出大事了。”
赫然就是那被滕老板派去叶石剑坊门口蹲点，最后目击一个个大人物来到叶石剑坊的情景，连忙跑回来报告的滕老板的工人。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Something big happened
The appearance of Ye Shi attracted the attention of all the children of the aristocratic family. It was only then that they remembered that the reason why Zhang Yang had this giant sword was entirely due to the sale of it by the person in front of him. So as long as they have a good relationship with the person in front of them, they can also get a sword of good quality.
"This eldest brother..." There was a young man from an aristocratic family who wanted to speak, but remembered that he didn't even know the other person's name. His face suddenly turned red and he was embarrassed to say any more.
"My name is Ye Shi, and I am a swordsmith." Ye Shi quickly solved the dilemma of the children of the aristocratic family. No one knew his name, and Ye Shi was very relaxed.
Originally, swordsmiths were not a particularly popular profession. With the development of sword civilization, sword users accounted for nine out of ten people in the world, and swordsmiths naturally followed suit. Unless they are very skilled swordsmiths and can create unparalleled swords, ordinary swordsmiths are worthless because there are too many of them.
It was only now that Ye Shi had proved his worth with a giant sword that the disciples of the aristocratic family paid attention to him and wanted to get closer to Ye Shi. Seeing that the giant sword in Zhang Yang's hand was so awesome, how could they be willing to use ordinary swords again? Swords are the foundation of spiritual practice, and no one wants to be slow in starting.
After Ye Shi said his name, he once again emphasized his identity as a swordsmith, because he was about to start deceiving him. Seeing his claim, the eyes of the disciples of the aristocratic family lit up. Ye Shi knew that he had succeeded in the first step, so he threw another bait, "The giant sword in Zhang Yang's hand was made by me."
Although they already knew it before, Ye Shi's affirmation at this time also made the disciples of the family become more enthusiastic, and some even joined in.
"Brother Ye Shi, I see that the giant sword in Zhang Yang's hand is of good quality and is a good sword. Being able to forge this sword shows that my brother's sword-making skills are extremely good." A young man from an aristocratic family immediately flattered him.
Although with their status, there is almost no one in Gaori City worthy of their flattery, but this matter is related to their own interests, and a little grievance is nothing.
"By the way, I haven't introduced myself yet." The young man from the aristocratic family smiled and said humbly, "My name is He Yong. If Brother Ye Shi doesn't mind, just call me He Yong."
"And me, my name is Xu Chaoping."
"My name is Huang Yunkai."
The children of the aristocratic family reported their names one after another and were very affectionate to Ye Shi. Fortunately, the people here this time were all men, so Ye Shi would not feel embarrassed. But because of this, Ye Shi got goosebumps and wondered whether he had fallen into the hands of Bei Beishan.
"Eldest brother?" Zhang Yang looked at Ye Shi nervously. He was afraid that his eldest brother would be deceived by the children of these aristocratic families. After finally recognizing his eldest brother, Zhang Yang didn't want to lose him like this.
"It's okay, we are all friends, let's communicate." Ye Shi smiled.
Being fooled away by a member of a noble family? How could Ye Shi be so confused by such a few words of flattery? As the saying goes, if flattery passes by his ears, gold coins will remain in his heart. Ye Shi was after the gold coins from the beginning. Was he cheating? That is Ye Shi's special skill. Apart from the unscrupulous customer service, who is Ye Shi's opponent?
Zhang Yang's eyes darkened when he heard this. Zhang Yang understood his elder brother's words very well, because his elder brother was a swordsmith and the owner of a sword workshop. It was normal to do business, but Zhang Yang still felt a little disappointed.
At this time, Ye Shi walked up to Zhang Yang, patted Zhang Yang on the shoulder, and whispered to Zhang Yang: "Don't worry, I am still your eldest brother. This time you will be rich after doing business. Big brother will help you reprocess the Juris to ensure that your Juris will be improved to the next level."
Ye Shi said this very softly, and no one except Zhang Yang heard it. To outsiders, Ye Shi seemed to be comforting Zhang Yang, who was lost. The disciples of the aristocratic family also expressed their understanding.
Only Zhang Yang's eyes lit up and he secretly said that his elder brother had not abandoned him and that he had made money from this business.It was also used to process the Jubii for him, which made Zhang Yang very moved again, and he felt ashamed for doubting his elder brother's thoughts before.
In fact, Zhang Yang misunderstood Ye Shi's meaning. Ye Shi said that after finishing the business, he would help him recycle Juhui for processing. But it didn't say that the money was used for it, but because Ye Shi's words were unclear and Zhang Yang had preconceptions, Zhang Yang thought so.
Seeing Zhang Yang's moved look, Ye Shi secretly exclaimed, "It's done." Yes, even if there are so many more customers, Zhang Yang's living advertisement cannot be stopped, because only Zhang Yang makes Ye Shi feel at ease. This is related to Zhang Yang's character, and Zhang Yang treats him as a big brother, so Ye Shi will naturally help him when it is cheap. Anyway, this is good for everyone. It is better to give it to others than to Zhang Yang.
"Brother Ye Shi, the giant sword in Zhang Yang's hand is very powerful, but we are all taking the flexible route, and the giant sword seems not suitable for us." Someone mentioned it at this time.
Ye Shi looked over, but he didn't expect that it was He Yong who said this. Obviously He Yong said what everyone was thinking. After He Yong said this, the disciples of the aristocratic family all nodded and looked at Ye Shi with hope, fearing that Ye Shi would say something regrettable.
"No problem." Ye Shi grinned, "I have several types of swords in my store, including light and sensitive ones, defensive ones, weird and changeable ones, everything you need. Even if you don't have one, you can still order it, and the quality will not be much worse than the current Juju. You can come to my store and you will understand."
Ye Shi's words made the disciples of the aristocratic family excited. They wanted to go over and take a look. If they were just impressed by the quality of Zhang Yang's giant sword before, then now they were impatient when they learned that there was a sword suitable for them. They wanted to hold the sword in their hands immediately.
"Everyone, please wait a moment. The shop has just opened and it's a bit complicated inside. Why don't you wait for me to go back and sort it out first, and come back later. How about you?" Ye Shi quickly stopped many children from aristocratic families who were about to leave.
Ye Shi was relieved when he saw many children from aristocratic families stopped. Although Ye Shi was very excited about so many fat sheep, they were not as good as Zhang Yang. It was hard for Ye Shi to believe the debts owed by these people. But if this will tell you, please prepare more gold coins, otherwise you will have no money to pay the bill later, which may cause public outrage.
Fortunately, Ye Shi also had a way. He recognized Zhang Yang as a younger brother just to be useful at this time, so Ye Shi explained a few words to Zhang Yang and left in a hurry.
Ye Shi could imagine what the expressions of these children of the aristocratic families would be like after Zhang Yang informed them of the price. Now Ye Shi could see clearly that the denominations of the gold coins were very large, even among the children of the aristocratic families.
Go back, open the shop, and wait. After Ye Shi finished everything, he sat at the counter and giggled. Although he heard a series of screams before leaving the manor, Ye Shi was not afraid that these children of aristocratic families would not take the bait. Even if a few don't come, Ye Shi will be satisfied if he earns only three or four.
At this time, the movements of Ye Shijianfang were also noticed by several weapon shops. They were still very concerned about such a newly opened competitive shop.
At this time, several weapons shop owners gathered together and sat in the tea room of Shuixie Inn, discussing how to suppress this new competitor. It was already difficult to do business, and now there are still people who want to take a share of the pie, so naturally the bosses won't allow it.
"Boss Song, what do you think we should do about Ye Shijianfang?" asked a fat man with big ears.
The boss Song who was asked was a middle-aged man with an average build. Judging from his gentle and elegant temperament, one would have thought he was a teacher rather than the owner of a weapons shop.
"Don't worry, I've already sent someone to inquire about it. The Yeshi Sword Shop is simple to set up. No equipment has been installed since I moved here. I'm afraid that if the swords are sold out, I will have to go to other places to pick up the swords. The quality will definitely not pass the test. For me,They are not much of a threat. "Boss Song took a sip of tea with a smile, and did not take the newly opened Ye Shi Jianfang seriously at all, "Besides, this Ye Shi Jianfang only has a young boss. Judging from his age, he is in his twenties at most. Whether it is sword making or business, he definitely lacks experience and is not a worry. "
"Then it seems that Ye Shijianfang will collapse on its own without us taking action," the rough man laughed.
"Boss Cai won't be worried now. "Another thin middle-aged man spoke at this time.
"Of course, listening to what you said, what do I have to worry about? These days, a boy with no hair growing up dares to come out and open a sword workshop. "Boss Cai shook his head for a while. His fat head and big ears looked extremely funny when he shook his head.
“Boss Cai, Boss Teng, we can’t take it lightly, be careful if the boat capsizes in the gutter. "Boss Song advised, but it showed on his face that even he himself didn't take these words to heart.
The other two bosses also laughed. Seeing Boss Song's calm and calm appearance, they had obviously analyzed Ye Shijianfang thoroughly. Thinking about how they looked like they were facing a formidable enemy before, they were indeed inferior to Boss Song in this regard. No wonder their store was always inferior to Boss Song.
"It's ridiculous that I just sent a person to squat at the gate of Ye Shijianfang and come back to report when there is a situation. It seems to be unnecessary. "Boss Teng laughed dryly, but said it first.
It would be shameless to say it now, but if it is exposed later when the person comes to report, the loss of face will be even greater. I hope that person can be smarter and not make a fuss about everything, otherwise he will lose a lot of face in front of the other two bosses.
Facts always violate people's expectations. Just when Boss Teng was still hoping that the person staying at the camp would not come over, he heard a familiar shout, and then a familiar figure appeared in front of them, running towards them.
While running, he shouted: "Boss, something big has happened, something big has happened. "
Surprisingly, it was Boss Teng's worker who was sent by Boss Teng to stay at the gate of Ye Shi Jian Fang. Finally, he witnessed the big shots coming to Ye Shi Jian Fang and quickly ran back to report.
